about: Curated input to prr_corpus.py build. Each bug seed names the merged pull request, the later pull request that fixed or reverted it, and one line on the defect. Clean seeds are controls: merged weeks to months ago, named by no later fix or revert. Public repositories only; private seeds live in the gitignored seeds.private.json.

defects.description: Let the agent read its sign-in from the keychain, which the lane sandbox denies to the tool it actually runs, so auth kept failing; reverted.
Label self-heal relabels a ticket mid fix round to loom:pr, letting the brain merge the head it had sent back; reverted.
Replaced a persistent volume with an emptyDir and seeded config from the empty mount on first boot, so the pod ran with no bots; reverted.
The intent check raised a high intent-mismatch on every pull request that linked acceptance criteria, blocking merges fleet-wide; reverted.
Deep-diff bound and settle timing disagreed with their documented values (inclusive vs exclusive bound, settle constant).
Deep review required both free-tier backends; one backend failing permanently made every review partial and nothing was ever published.
Removing the in-cluster synthetic probe dropped the required post-deploy liveness and readiness validation.
The release synthetic still probed through a port-forward that cannot bind on these nodes, so every deploy false-failed and rolled back.
Widened the static-credential tripwire so proof tests that scrubbed only one half of the pair failed in CI; merged over the red check.
Moved the IaC deploy to a hosted runner that lacks uv, which the workflow assumed was preinstalled; deploys silently stopped.
Static-site rewrite rules tripped the host's pretty-URL canonicalization, redirecting the landing page to the app route.
A copied module kept the wrong logger name, and the acceptance error message named a section the author did not use.
Re-recording an installation overwrote its installed_at timestamp in a racy read-modify-write.
The session HMAC did not cover the user id appended to the cookie, so a signed-in user could load another user's row; cookie max age also outlived the state TTL.
Changed the published image without updating the manifest's pinned digest, turning main red on the pin guard.
Per-leg downstream endpoints made traffic flow one way only, taking the bond down on deploy; reverted.
Gated the asset CLI on a directory that exists only inside the deployment, breaking the documented laptop step, and printed a backing state it never read; reverted.
Cut certificate lifetime to 21 days although its own body held the merge until renewal was proven on hardware; reverted.
Diagnostics path returned an unreachable result without logging the caught failure, and a zero sentinel on a monotonic clock refused the first upload.
Treated an object quest ender with no static spawn as missing, so quests whose ender is script-summoned were abandoned as broken.
Flipped a stated capability flag and inverted its tests with no matching module change, so the UI reported behavior the module does not have.
Added planning helpers and tests that nothing calls, duplicating constants another module owns, while the ticket was closed as done; reverted.
Queue filter compared a raw keyword against a wing id, so it could keep rows it meant to drop or empty the queue; reverted.
Removed a weapon type from a class table with a test asserting a false game rule, hiding a health finding instead of fixing it; reverted.
A bank floor turned a health finding off by paying members less, and named no cause as its criteria required; reverted.
A synchronous read-back raced an asynchronous commit, so a letter whose gold had left could be reported unsent and the refund posted twice.
Let a headless roster leader hold a run's leading seat, contradicting the rule that a run's leader has a client; reverted.
Terrain grounding sampled ground height along a step but never checked line of sight, so characters stepped through walls.
Dropped follow from party members in a dungeon run on a false premise, so the party stopped or arrived piecemeal and died.
Published a benchmark row no run produced; its percentages fit no possible denominator; reverted.
